AGENDA
  GLENDALE AUDIT COMMITTEE
  MUNICIPAL SERVICES BUILDING
  633 E. Broadway, Room 105
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.
  JULY 25, 2024 AT 2:00 PM

1.  ROLL CALL

2.  BUSINESS AGENDA
  a. Report of Recording Secretary, re: Posting of Agenda
  The Agenda for the July 25, 2024 Audit Committee Meeting was posted on July 18, 2024,
  on the bulletin board outside City Hall.

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
   Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed 3 minutes. The
  Committee may question or respond to the speaker but there will be no debate or decision.
  The Audit Committee Chair may refer the matter to staff for investigation and report.

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  a. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on April 25, 2024.

5.  ACTION ITEMS
  a. Election of Audit Committee Chair
  b. Election of Audit Committee Secretary
  c. Annual Report to City Council

6.  REPORTS - INFORMATION
  a. Report from CliftonLarsonAllen, LLP on the Audit of FY ended June 30, 2024 – Alwin
  DeLeon, Finance Accounting Manager
  b. Internal Audit Activity Report as of June 30, 2024 – Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Principal
  Internal Auditor
  c. FY 2024 Audit Work Plan Review and Proposed FY 2025 Audit Work Plan – Natalie
  Minami-Valdivia, Principal Internal Auditor

7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS

8.  NEW BUSINESS

9.  ADJOURNMENT
minutes_text:
CITY OF GLENDALE
  AUDIT COMMITTEE MINUTES
  July 25, 2024

1.  ROLL CALL: 2:02 PM
  Present: Edwin Belen, Edmund Khashadourian, Jack Mavyan (joined the
  meeting at 2:05 PM), Alejandro Parajon
  Absent:
2.  BUSINESS AGENDA:
  A. Posting of Agenda
  The Agenda for the Audit Committee meeting of July 25, 2024, was posted on
  July 18, 2024, on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.
3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  None.

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

  A. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on April 25, 2024

  Moved: Edwin Belen  Seconded: Jack Mavyan
  Vote as follows:
  Ayes: Edwin Belen, Jack Mavyan, Alejandro Parajon
  Noes:
  Absent:
  Abstain: Edmund Khashadourian

5.  ACTION ITEMS:

  A. Election of Audit Committee Chair

  Committee member Edmund Khashadourian nominated Mr. Alejandro Parajon to
  continue as the Audit Committee Chair. No other nominations were made.

  Vote as follows:
  Ayes: Edwin Belen, Edmund Khashadourian, Alejandro Parajon

  1
   Noes:
  Absent: Jack Mavyan
  Abstain:

  B. Election of Audit Committee Secretary

  Chair Alejandro Parajon nominated staff from the Management Services
  Department to continue providing staff to act as Secretary of the Audit
  Committee. No other nominations were made.

  C. Annual Report to City Council

  Chair Alejandro Parajon read the Annual Report to City Council into the record.

  Moved: Edwin Belen  Seconded: Edmund Khashadourian

  Vote as follows:

  Ayes: Edwin Belen, Edmund Khashadourian, Jack Mavyan, Alejandro Parajon
  Noes:
  Absent:
  Abstain:

6.  REPORTS – INFORMATION:

  A. Report from CliftonLarsonAllen, LLP on the Audit of FY ended June 30,
  2024 – Alwin DeLeon, Finance Accounting Manager

  Mr. Alwin DeLeon, Finance Accounting Manager, introduced Ms. Daphnie
  Munoz, Partner at CliftonLarsonAllen, LLP, who subsequently presented the
  report on the Audit of FY ended June 30, 2024 to the Audit Committee and
  answered questions from the Committee members.
  B. Internal Audit Activity Report as of June 30, 2024 – Natalie Minami-
  Valdivia, Principal Internal Auditor

  Ms. Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Principal Internal Auditor, provided a report to the
  Audit Committee on the Internal Audit activity for the quarter ended on June 30,
  2024.
  Ms. Minami-Valdivia made a presentation on the PCI Compliance Audit. Ms.
  Minami-Valdivia and Ms. Guia Murray, Assistant City Treasurer, answered
  questions from the Committee members.
  Ms. Minami-Valdivia made a presentation on the Records Management System -
  FileNet Audit. Ms. Minami-Valdivia, Mr. Hagop Hovsepian, Assistant Chief

  2
   Information Officer/Apps, and Mr. Tao Li, Departmental Apps Manager,
  answered questions from the Committee members.
  After the audit presentation, Ms. Minami-Valdivia continued presenting the
  Internal Audit activity report for the quarter. She covered projects in progress,
  continuous audits, quarterly follow-up status on outstanding audit issues, and
  advisory services.
  C. FY 2024 Audit Work Plan Review and Proposed FY 2025 Audit Work
  Plan – Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Principal Internal Auditor

  Ms. Natalie Minami-Valdivia provided a report to the Audit Committee on the FY
  2024 Audit Work Plan Status Update and the FY 2025 Proposed Audit Work Plan
  and answered questions from the Committee members.

7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS:

  Chair Alejandro Parajon shared that Committee member Thomas
  O’Shaughnessy, who served on the Audit Committee for seven years, passed
  away. He expressed his condolences and observed a moment of silence in Mr.
  O’Shaughnessy’s memory. Committee members also expressed their
  condolences.

8.  NEW BUSINESS:

  None.

9.  ADJOURNMENT:

  Moved: Edmund Khashadourian  Seconded: Edwin Belen

Adjournment at 4:00 PM
